stops.name: St. Beatus Caves
stops.quote: In the St. Beatus Caves by Lake Thun near Interlaken.
stops.english: In the St. Beatus Caves by Lake Thun near Interlaken.

stops.name: walkways
stops.quote: Explore around one kilometre of safe and well-lit walkways inside the mountain.
stops.english: Explore around one kilometre of safe and well-lit walkways inside the mountain.

stops.name: stalactites
stops.quote: Discover stalactites and stalagmites that have been formed by nature over millions of years as you immerse yourself in this unique underground world.
stops.english: Discover stalactites and stalagmites that have been formed by nature over millions of years as you immerse yourself in this unique underground world.

stops.name: Cave Museum
stops.quote: A visit to the Cave Museum is a chance to learn more about this natural wonder, with an audio guide telling you all you need to know about caves and caving.
stops.english: A visit to the Cave Museum is a chance to learn more about this natural wonder, with an audio guide telling you all you need to know about caves and caving.
